title: Systems Simulation & Balance Workbench
objective: Provide deterministic/stochastic batch simulation for game-system parameters, resource flows, economies, encounters and cross-system scenarios using owner-domain rules. Support parameter sweeps, seeded Monte Carlo runs, sensitivity comparisons, target envelopes, regression baselines and exportable evidence. The workbench recommends/proves; it does not silently rebalance canonical rules.

scope.purpose: Provide deterministic and seeded stochastic simulation/balance evidence over owner-domain rules without becoming canonical gameplay/economy/combat authority or silently changing tuned values.
scope.completion_gate: Representative owner-domain rules and parameter projections can be evaluated through deterministic/seeded stochastic simulations with inspectable inputs, seeds, comparisons, target/regression evidence and exports while recommendations remain non-authoritative and invalid rule/parameter/reference states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01..11 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.
PCA-02 retained deterministic/repeatable graph, variant, budget, cache and provenance planning authority; PCA-12 reused deterministic planning patterns without becoming gameplay-rule authority.
MIB-13 retained economy/value/market/settlement authority; PCA-12 consumed explicit economy projections only and mutated no balances, prices, markets, settlement state or economy truth.
A7 retained authoritative combat-encounter lifecycle/state/version authority; PCA-12 consumed encounter projections only and did not create or transition authoritative encounters.

Other gameplay/content systems entered only through explicit owner-rule/parameter projections with stable owner authority references; PCA-12 created no parallel canonical rule ledger and inferred no missing rules.

Seeded stochastic outputs, parameter sweeps, Monte Carlo runs, sensitivity comparisons, target envelopes and regression baselines remained reproducible, inspectable and advisory; no silent rebalance or canonical mutation was performed.
No provider/network execution, paid-service activation, public upload, publication, release or owner-domain state mutation was performed.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-12 publication. PCA-12 unlocks no new interstitial studio/rotation start; MCS, MCCS and MSAS remain blocked by PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER. PCA-13 gates PCA-02 and CNI-10 are satisfied, so PCA-13 is the lawful next selected item.

PCA-13 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-14+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
